# Feature: Secret redaction

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #38 -->

## Intent
Canary secrets in inputs/headers must never land in an artifact (EDGE-008, NFR-006, T-011). Password fields, tokens, cookies, Authorization headers, and request bodies are not stored by default.

Roadmap: Epic 8 Quality & Security.

## Preconditions
- Scenario engine (#15) and artifact store (#5) exist
- Quick Scan writes artifacts (#18)

## Happy Path
- [ ] A canary secret in recorded input does not appear in the written artifact
- [ ] Authorization headers and request bodies are dropped by default
- [ ] `secretRef` remains a name, never a value
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Secret in a URL query (`token`, `password`, `api_key`, …) is redacted
- [ ] `Authorization: Bearer …` is not stored
- [ ] Denied keys are matched case-insensitively

## Regression
- [ ] Quick Scan still writes a schema-valid artifact
- [ ] Golden artifact tests still pass
- [ ] Scope: `packages/scenario-engine/**`, artifact write path, canary tests — no dashboard, no OS keychain

## Assumptions
- Redaction is deny-by-default for known sensitive keys plus a text scrubber for Bearer/query leftovers
- The canary string is a test fixture, not a real credential

## Security Coverage
- F-03: no tokens/passwords stored in artifacts
- NFR-006 / T-011: 0 hits of the canary in written artifacts
- P-02: errors do not echo secret values after redaction
- B-04: N/A (no SQL/shell)

## Screenshots
Not applicable.

## Implementation Notes
- `packages/scenario-engine/src/redact.ts`: deny-by-default for Authorization/cookies/bodies/password/token keys; URL query redaction; `secretRef` kept only when it looks like a name.
- Scenario driver receives redacted steps. Artifact JSON is scrubbed (`Bearer`, query, sensitive JSON keys) before `writeCompleted`.
- T-011 canary tests: unit, engine, Quick Scan write path, golden store round-trip.
- 92 tests; `pnpm checks` green.

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
- Event: recorded input/header → redact → driver/artifact JSON → scrub → store.
- Missing/denied keys fail closed (dropped). Canary never stored.
- No queue/fan-out.
